Notes: Matched against 85+ known Nairobi sub-locations (longest-match-first). Defaults to "Nairobi" when sub-location cannot be parsed. Standardise and group sparse areas in Day 2.

Notes: "None" if no keywords detected. 30 amenity types scanned across all sources. In Day 2, derive amenity_score = number of amenities detected.

Notes: Absolute or relative (e.g. "3 days ago"). N/A on sources that do not expose listing dates (PropertyPro, KPC, Maploti). Normalise in Day 2 to derive the month feature.
